---
short: Resolved value
title: "Title {{< meta short >}}"
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
citation: true
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"][content="Title Resolved value"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas', '.quarto-appendix-bibtex']
        matches: ['Resolved']
        noMatches: ['\{\{<']
---

A shortcode in the title is resolved before the citation title is converted.
